lines.t: In R.E.P.O., you're a little robot, carrying priceless valuables past monsters.
lines.say: In Repo, you're a little robot, carrying priceless valuables past monsters.

lines.t: Up to six players are Semibots. Get valuables to the extraction point without breaking them, and earn surplus to spend on upgrades.
R.E.P.O. stands for Retrieve, Extract, and Profit Operation.
lines.say: Repo stands for Retrieve, Extract, and Profit Operation.

lines.t: It was made by Semiwork, and hit 230,000 players at once on its first weekend.
It even topped Steam's sales charts for a week.
